name: v0
tagline: Vercel's AI builder: describe an app or interface and get working full-stack code you can deploy.
about: v0 turns a description into a working web app. It writes the code, shows a live preview and lets you refine it by chatting, then deploys to Vercel.
pros: Generates real code you can export and edit.
cons: Works best within the Vercel and Next.js stack.
Credits run out quickly on larger projects.
